The network broadcasts a timed registration puzzle requiring each node to solve a unique cryptographic work factor bound to a randomly selected epoch seed, secured by an upstream hardware root resembling a cedar module. Because the seed is unreleased until the window opens, spawning a sybil cluster requires computing hashes blindly without precomputation.
